judgement.title: APM PMS Q&A SOP: the session run on Monday 26 October 2026 on Friday 23 October's closing prices, for your session on Tuesday 27 October
judgement.heading: Xvivo | Middle Innings Core Investment, sell signal, held under your one-off in/out link | 5.05% of the fund's capital in 3 tranches | outside the order of sale: sold by the 30% tranche rule when released
judgement.markdown:
- **Industry:** Xvivo is in Healthcare. Healthcare's Industry RS was 79 at the Friday 23 October reading (53 four weeks earlier)
- **Sector:** Xvivo is in Medtech, consumables. That sector's Sector RS was 27 at the 30 September month-end (20 at the August month-end); on Friday's daily reading it was 66
  - Xvivo's sector's other companies, with their daily Stock RS: Alcon (38), Fresenius (52), Straumann (57), Sonova (94), Coloplast (51), Smith & Nephew (30), and 15 more
- **Cohort:** Xvivo is in Fast-growing niche medtech. The cohort's relative strength was 49 on Friday's daily reading (33 four weeks earlier). Xvivo's cohort's other companies: Ambu (46), Bonesupport (97), Vitrolife (50), Surgical Science (98)
- **Xvivo's charts are on Xvivo's page on the PMS Per-stock Dashboard:** https://vfhqi.github.io/ratings/pms/holding.html?t=XVIVO-SE

**What is going on, and why it matters**
- **The price move, by beta:** over five sessions Xvivo's shares fell about 11%; Xvivo's beta of 1.19 explains about 2%, so Xvivo's own move was about -10%, 1.4 times its usual size, larger than usual
  - The dated news: Xvivo's third-quarter results on Thursday 22 October beat the analysts on sales (SEK 252.6 million against about SEK 238 million) and on profit before depreciation (SEK 52 million against about SEK 46 million), with the heart system's European approval in hand since August
  - The same report said Xvivo's largest United States lung customer has approval for its own lung platform and will buy less from Xvivo, and about SEK 19 million of the quarter was timing; Xvivo's shares fell 7.8% on Friday 23 October
- **The sector:** Xvivo's sector's companies rose about 3% over the same five sessions, so the Xvivo fall is Xvivo's own
- **Your note of 17 October is still right on both counts:** Xvivo's Friday close of SEK 206.00 is about 16% below its 200-day moving average (SEK 244.02), and all three Xvivo tranches met the 30% tranche rule on 2 October
- **The analysts:** for Xvivo, Net Upgrade Breadth, sales estimates was 0% and Net Upgrade Breadth, target prices -14% at the 30 September month-end; Xvivo's Sell-side Momentum rating is F

**What it means for the position**
- **Holding:** only the 30% tranche rule's release window keeps Xvivo; three whole-holding Sell Criteria are also met, held back by your one-off in/out link
- **Selling:** Xvivo's three tranches are sold at the first session after a close at or above SEK 236.90 (15% above the lowest close since 2 October, which is Friday's SEK 206.00), or after the 63rd trading day from 2 October (around the end of December)
  - Because Friday's close is the new low since 2 October, the release level moved down from about SEK 237.13; a 15% recovery within weeks is unlikely, so the end-of-December date is now the more likely release
- **Adding:** not allowed, because Xvivo meets a Sell Criterion
- **Why Xvivo is outside the order of sale:** the 30% tranche rule sells Xvivo's tranches whatever is bought, and your one-off in/out link does not hold back a tranche sale

**What we could lose:** nothing more to Xvivo's 30% level, because Xvivo's price is already about 5% below it; Xvivo is now about 3.9% of the fund at UBS's Friday weights, against 5.05% at purchase sizes

**Experiment: which stocks Xvivo's own moves have tracked** (last 3 and 6 months)
- **Vimian** (same country of listing): 0.30 and 0.13, weak
- **Wallenstam** (same country of listing): 0.28 and 0.17, weak
- **Demant** (same sector): 0.27 and 0.18, weak
- **Camurus** (same country of listing): 0.23 and 0.13, weak
- **My reading:** Xvivo's moves are mostly its own; Xvivo's own news decides Xvivo's price

**The Investment Analyst's new memo on Xvivo (written 25 October at SEK 223.40, published 26 October; read from the memo's summary, because the new memo has no separate digest)**
- **Decided:** the new memo on Xvivo calls Xvivo "a predictable business inside an unpredictable security": the fundamentals skew positive over two to three years, while the next two to three reports skew towards estimate cuts
- **Must happen:** European heart-system sales ramping from the first quarter of 2027, the analysts resetting 2027 earnings per share down by about 25% to 35%, and the United States regulator's approach to the heart application visible by mid-2027
- **Main risk:** the analysts' 2027 and 2028 earnings are about 36% to 37% above the memo's own, because they have not yet carried the new approval's amortisation, a normal tax rate and the end of currency gains; the downside to the memo's fair trough is SEK 110 to SEK 140, about 32% to 47% below Friday's close
- **Expected return (the Modal return):** about +90% over eighteen months on the memo's own central multiple (from SEK 223.40), above our bar, but only after the estimate cuts have been absorbed
- **Next test:** Xvivo's fourth-quarter report on 28 January 2027

**My judgement:** bearish on the Xvivo position over the next three months, neutral beyond that, medium conviction: let the release rule sell it
- The rule and the new memo agree on the near term: the memo expects a run of estimate cuts that the price has only started to absorb, which is what the three Sell Criteria and the 30% fall are reading
- **Counter-case:** the memo's long-term return is far above our bar, and selling around the end of December may sell near the bottom of the estimate-cut cycle; a sale before then would need you to lift your one-off in/out link for Xvivo, which I do not recommend while Theon waits

**What would change my view:** a close at or above SEK 236.90 (which releases the tranches); the analysts' 2027 estimates falling to the memo's level faster than the memo expects

items.criterion: MA SLs (the five-day stop rule, each tranche)
items.text: All three Xvivo tranches' MA SL exits were confirmed before your 27-Oct ruling and are unsold (tranche 2 on 14-Jul, tranche 3 on 14-Sep, tranche 1 on 21-Sep), so whether they sell is your ruling on open case 1 and, as Xvivo is under your one-off in/out link, open case 3; tranche 2, back above its stop from 30-Jul to 16-Sep, adds case 2. The trend is away from the stops: Xvivo's 27-Oct close of SEK 202.0 needs a 17.3% rise to regain tranche 3's stop (SEK 237.02, on the 50D MA) and 26.3% to regain the stop of tranches 1 and 2 (SEK 255.06, on the 150D MA). The fall is Xvivo's own: it lost 12.0% in the five sessions to 27-Oct after a 22-Oct third-quarter beat in which it said its largest United States lung customer will buy less, while Healthcare rose 2.8%. Still below their stops, all three Xvivo tranches (5.05% of capital) would sell at the Tue 3-Nov session under my picks for questions 1 and 2 (sell the tranches still below their stops at the 30-Oct close; exits under the link do not wait).

items.criterion: Sell Criterion 6 (a tranche 30% below its highest close since purchase, with Stock RS below 70)
items.text: Sell Criterion 6 triggered all three Xvivo tranches on 2-Oct (a close of SEK 213.6 against the SEK 216.3 level, 30% below the SEK 309.0 high of 13-Aug, with Stock RS 34), and all three are in the release window. Xvivo's release comes on a close at or above SEK 232.30 (15% above the 27-Oct close, the low, so the level falls with each new low) or on the 63rd trading day after 2-Oct (about 5-Jan-2027 on the count in item 8 (Distance from SLs)), and the tranches then sell at the next Tuesday session, which your one-off in/out link does not hold back. The risk runs the other way from usual: any Xvivo recovery reaches SEK 232.30 before it clears Sell Criterion 5 (about SEK 243.75) or regains an MA SL, so a 15% rebound sells all three tranches. Xvivo's October rally stopped 2.0% short of that leg's release level (SEK 237.13), and no up day of 5% or more on heavy volume, the sign that ended three of Xvivo's last five declines, has appeared since 7-Oct.

items.criterion: Sell Criterion 5 (relative price more than 25% below its 52W high, read at the month-end)
items.text: Met at the 30-Sep reading and deepening: on 27-Oct Xvivo's relative price is 37.9% below its 21-Apr 52W high, its lowest since 5-Mar-2026, from 31.5% at the 30-Sep reading, 28.7% on 20-Oct and 22.0% on 28-Jul. Xvivo's relative price led its SP down: it did not confirm the SP's 13-Aug high and crossed below its own 200D MA on 16-Sep, six sessions before the SP did. Clearing Sell Criterion 5 at the Fri 30-Oct reading would need an Xvivo close of about SEK 243.75 at a flat market, 20.7% above the 27-Oct close, so it will very probably read as met again. With Sell Criteria 3 and 4, Sell Criterion 5 has kept the whole Xvivo holding (5.05% of capital) awaiting its replacement under your one-off in/out link since the sale first due at the Tue 6-Oct session.

items.criterion: Sell Criterion 4 (Stock RS below 50 with revenue or PT Net Upgrade Breadth below zero, read at the month-end)
items.text: Met at the 30-Sep reading and much deeper on 27-Oct: Xvivo's Stock RS is 12 (56 a month earlier, 53 on 16-Oct, 20 on 23-Oct), its revenue Net Upgrade Breadth (71%), with 5 of 7 analysts cutting and none raising, and its PT Net Upgrade Breadth (43%), with 3 of 7 cutting and none raising. Xvivo's analysts have cut harder since the 30-Sep reading, most of all around the 22-Oct report: revenue breadth went from 0% at 30-Sep to (29%) from 7-Oct and (71%) from 23-Oct, and FY2027 (year to Dec-27) EPS consensus fell 8.9% from 29-Sep to 26-Oct (SEK 6.04 to SEK 5.50). Xvivo's Stock-specific Investment Case A&J Memo of 26-Oct expects more cuts, consensus settling near SEK 5.5 and then falling toward SEK 4.0 to 4.5 by the third-quarter 2027 report. Clearing Sell Criterion 4 by Fri 30-Oct would need Xvivo's Stock RS at 50 or more, or both breadths at zero or above, so it will very probably read as met again.

items.criterion: Sell Criterion 3 (Sector RS below 50 with Stock RS below 70, read at the month-end)
items.text: Met at the 30-Sep reading, and met on 27-Oct by one point on the Framework 14 figures: the Sector RS of Xvivo's sector, medtech consumables, is 49 (27 at the 30-Sep reading, 66 on 23-Oct) and Xvivo's Stock RS 12, though the chart's own series reads 50 on 27-Oct, which would not meet it (the rule acts on the Framework 14 figure). Medtech consumables' Sector RS has moved by up to 23 points a week since mid-September (+20 and +23 in the two weeks to 23-Oct), so the Fri 30-Oct reading can land either side of 50, and a sector rise to 50 or more is the only way any of Xvivo's met Sell Criteria can clear by 30-Oct. The context is Xvivo falling alone in a rising cohort: in the week to 27-Oct Bonesupport rose 27.2% and Vitrolife 14.4% while Xvivo fell 12.0%, and Xvivo's Stock RS of 12 compares with 42 to 98 for its four cohort peers. Even if Sell Criterion 3 clears, Sell Criteria 4 and 5 keep the whole Xvivo holding awaiting its replacement under your one-off in/out link.

items.criterion: Sell Criterion 2 (the 200D MA of relative price flat or falling over the month, read each Friday)
items.text: Not met but flattening fast: the 200D MA of Xvivo's relative price rose 0.34% over the month to 27-Oct, against 0.55% at the 23-Oct reading and 2.92% on 28-Jul. On the projection in item 8 (Distance from SLs), an unchanged Xvivo relative price gives about 0.03% on Fri 30-Oct (not met) and (0.50%) on Fri 6-Nov (met), while a relative fall averaging about 2.1% (an SP near SEK 197.7 at a flat market) meets it on 30-Oct. Avoiding Sell Criterion 2 on 6-Nov would need Xvivo's relative price about 16% higher, so it is likely to join Xvivo's met Sell Criteria by then. Met, it adds to Sell Criteria 3, 4 and 5 without changing what the rules do: the whole Xvivo holding stays awaiting its replacement under your one-off in/out link.

items.criterion: Sell Criterion 1 (Industry RS below 30, read each Friday)
items.text: Far, and moving away: the Industry RS of Xvivo's industry, Healthcare, is 79 on 27-Oct (53 at the 30-Sep reading), and Healthcare made a 52W high on 27-Oct, leading the month's rotation into defensives. The rotation into defensives can turn: Healthcare's Industry RS read 26 at the 7-Aug Friday reading, below the 30 that meets Sell Criterion 1. Healthcare's strength has not helped Xvivo, whose fall is its own: Xvivo's Stock-specific Investment Case A&J Memo of 26-Oct finds 91% of Xvivo's variance stock-specific.
